## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New step action or option
- [ ] Render or camera change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling or dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] A line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md` for anything users will notice
- [ ] Commit messages follow `feat:`, `fix:`, `perf:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `ci:`, `build:` or `revert:`
- [ ] A still or a short clip for changes to the video
